editor.canaryNote: Empty: every client. Clients outside the canary run in shadow; the control plane forces shadow if the canary does worse than its shadow group.
editor.plugins: CRS plugins (rule exclusions for an application)
editor.pluginsNote: On the application's known paths and fields, a plugin takes listed CRS rules or targets away so its normal traffic does not match; only for policies in front of that application. The deployed rule set must contain the plugin (rules/crs-plugins). Nodes must run a module that supports the setting.
editor.paranoiaNote: Higher levels catch more attacks and raise false positives: about 9% of benign requests match at level 2. Rules above the enforced level up to the shadow level are only reported, never block. Try a level in shadow and review its false positives before enforcing it. Nodes must run a module that supports the setting.
